notes: Sanctum of All. Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a Shrine card and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' At turn 3's upkeep seat 0 fires the may and searches its graveyard only (option 2): Shrine G comes from the graveyard onto the battlefield under seat 0's control; Shrine L in the library is never looked at and stays. The library was not searched, so it is NOT shuffled: after the draw step takes the top filler (Library 5), the remaining order is the original one, Library 4 down to Library 0, then the plain Enchantment and Shrine L.
